## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem, the change, and any relevant issue links.

## Validation

List checks run and results. Explain omitted checks and remaining compatibility risks.
Include screenshots when they help review a visual change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and formatted.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; regression coverage is included where useful.
- [ ] User documentation and the changelog reflect behavior changes.
- [ ] No generated packages, credentials, or private data are included.
